direction.name: 같은 테이블의 공간
direction.organization: One continuous oblique table scene spans the full width and depth. Two neighbors repairing chair and garment anchor opposite ends; the open table between real activities supports a connected plane of overlaid flat typesetting, with no separate right text column.
direction.concept: Cooperation is a visible exchange of a real screwdriver and fabric across a busy neighborhood table. Two people shown with believable working postures, repaired objects grounded in real contact.
direction.image_grammar: Painterly gouache with bold precise silhouettes, nuanced warm coral, deep aubergine and light yellow-green color relationships. Active table objects, human interaction and table edges structure the whole field. Not an empty studio wall; not glossy clay.
direction.body_flow: Title follows the table opening centrally, description in a broad connected paragraph immediately below it, event/date/time/place and participation group next to one another along the same table-directed reading axis. Enough open image area is designed for large clean upright body; copy floats in a flat graphic plane, never foreshortened on the physical table.
direction.type: Precisely printed mature Korean sans with open counters, low stroke contrast, stable widths. Title expressive but not oversized; small copy no brush texture.
direction.distinctness: A single continuous human scene with center-integrated copy and a depth-directed reading axis; no strip sequence, graph network, framed comic modules or cut-image comparison.

common_constraints: Resolve the actual whole structure and readable body area first; material names are subordinate to that design.
Use the already-collected design idea library; no fresh browsing, no source re-opening or source paperwork. No source raster is a client asset.
Each native prompt prints the full required copy once, chosen positive visual relationships and relevant conditions; no rubric or JSON dump.

720px-wide social/community display is a coordinator design assumption, not a new client-fixed pixel/font/layout requirement. Mature body typically14–18px at that display implies ample paragraph area, not tiny footer print.
Coordinator relationships are design guidance; actual successful distinct relationships may vary without repairs to match coordinates.
Do not inspect peers or external critic feedback; preserve every initial and bounded repair and close own selection first.

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
